condition: When read_xml's iterparse list repeats a child name (e.g. {"row": ["a", "a"]}) and the file is larger than the parser buffer, some values come back NaN or end up in the wrong column, with no warning.
workaround: Don't repeat child names in the iterparse list. Read the file with the xpath path instead, or parse it yourself and read element text only on "end" events.
